Subject: Mutual action plan and security/compliance materials for evaluation

Hi Sophia,

Great to meet virtually yesterday — thanks again for the time. Per our call, I attached a first draft of a mutual action plan (MAP) that aligns with FinTechX's evaluation window and procurement milestones. Key checkpoints in the MAP include:
- Security/compliance review (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ)
- DPA review and redlines
- Pilot/POC enrollment and data retention controls
- Final procurement & sign-off

Attachments: MAP_Redwood-FinTechX_v1.pdf (MAP), SIG_CAIX-Filled-20260301.xlsx (pre-filled CAIQ), SOC2_Redwood_Inference_2025-TypeII.pdf (SOC 2 report stub)

Could you confirm the target procurement close date you mentioned on the call and whether your legal team prefers redlines in Word or DocuSign? If helpful, I'm happy to loop in our legal and security leads to answer the CAIQ and retention questions directly.

Proposed timeline from our side: evaluation & security review by 2026-03-12, DPA final by 2026-03-18, pilot start week of 2026-03-22.

Next steps: If that looks reasonable, we'll: 1) share SOC2 artifacts and the CAIQ spreadsheet in a shared Drive, 2) open a DocuSign DPA for your redlines, 3) schedule a focused session with our security engineer to run through the CAIQ items you flag.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0123

Marissa —

Thanks for the MAP and materials. Quick clarifying questions from our security and procurement teams:
1) Can you confirm Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report date and whether there are any subservice organizations called out?
2) We prefer the completed CAIQ but may have a few follow-ups — could you confirm who on your team will be the SME for the CAIQ?
3) Data retention: for logs and request traces generated during the POC, we need a retention policy and the ability to request deletions after the pilot. Is that supported?
4) DPA: we'll do initial redlines in Word and then move to DocuSign for signature. Can you send a copy of the current DPA with your baseline data residency and deletion language?

Target timeline for us: we'd like to be closed with procurement by ~2026-03-15 if possible. If that's tight on your side, let us know which milestones you can compress.

Best,
Sophia Reed
Head of Integrations
FinTechX Inc.
Sophia.reed@fintechx.com
(212) 555-0488
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Sophia —

Thanks — looping in Neha (Legal) and Vivek (Security/Platform) so they can answer the CAIQ/DPA/retention items directly. Quick answers while they chime in:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for the period ending 2025-12-31. There are two subservice orgs listed (cloud infra provider and a monitoring vendor) — we'll provide the cover letter and binding statement in the Drive.
- CAIQ SME: Vivek will be the primary SME for the CAIQ. He can run a 60-minute walkthrough of any flagged areas next week.
- Data retention & deletion: we support per-customer retention settings for PII/exchange logs in our platform; deletion requests are handled via an authenticated support workflow and logged. For the POC we can set retention to 30 days by default and provide deletion within 48 hours of an approved request.

I've uploaded all artifacts to the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-RW-FinTechX-MAP (contains SOC2_Redwood_Inference_2025-TypeII.pdf, SIG_CAIX-Filled-20260301.xlsx, MAP_Redwood-FinTechX_v1.pdf). Vivek — are you available for a CAIQ walkthrough on 2026-03-05 or 2026-03-08?

Marissa

Hi Sophia,

Thanks for the questions — I've attached our baseline DPA with callouts where FinTechX typically requests modifications. For the procurement timeline, we can accommodate your preference to redline in Word; once we have a clean redline we'll circulate a DocuSign envelope.

A few notes on the DPA and residency:
- Baseline residency: US-based regions (multi-region failover). If you require a strict US-only clause, please flag the exact language and we will review with infra (changes may affect SLA/pricing).
- Deletion & access: Article 4 covers deletion requests; standard turnaround 48-72 hours for POC data with logged confirmation.
- Security attestation: SOC 2 Type II report is included in the Drive. Additional evidence (pen test summary, architecture diagram) can be provided under an NDA if needed.

DocuSign link (will be populated once we have your redlines): https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Sign?e=RW-FTX-DPA-2026

If procurement needs a verbal confirmation from leadership for the committed timeline, Laura can provide a one-line approval.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Assistant General Counsel
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Neha —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the artifacts. Confirming next steps from our side:
- Procurement will do a first-pass redline on the DPA today and send back by 2026-03-11.
- Security team will review the CAIQ spreadsheet and send any follow-ups by 2026-03-10; they would like the CAIQ walkthrough on 2026-03-11 at 10:00 AM ET if Vivek is available.
- We're OK with the proposed POC retention (30 days + deletion within 48 hours) for the pilot.

Given internal approvals, our updated target close date is 2026-03-18 (pushing out a few days from the aggressive date we mentioned earlier). Please let us know if that affects any commitments on Redwood's side.

Final ask: can you confirm whether any of the SOC 2 subservice orgs have access to raw request payloads during the POC? We need that explicitly documented.

Thanks — excited to get the pilot started.

Best,
Sophia Reed

FinTechX Inc.
